title: Funds held in a dollar stablecoin before they move on
summary: The funds wait in a dollar stablecoin for 2 to 30 days and then move to a new wallet. The wait avoids price changes during laundering.

basis.note: No source read for this design publishes how often a screening tool loses the link at this method. The value is an assumption and means that the trail is lost in 0 cases in 100.

a new wallet that receives the funds

steps.say: After a wait the funds move to a new wallet.

basis.note: The report says that proceeds are held in dollar tokens to avoid price changes during laundering. The wait of 2 to 30 days is assumed.
